amendments.reason: The preregistered per-seed confirmation exposed top-1 safety variance. Before any holdout label generation or access, lock a three-seed predicted-factor ensemble with a validation-only safety/margin calibration and frozen-WoTE fallback.
amendments.scientific_change: Inference selection policy only; no model, loss, representation, candidate, label, or checkpoint changes.

amendments.reason: The A1 validation-locked policy retained score gain on the designated development set but its false-safe constraint did not transfer. Use the already preregistered threshold/margin grid on the designated dev split for the final safety lock, then evaluate exactly once on the untouched holdout.
amendments.scientific_change: Calibration split for the existing inference grid only; checkpoints, model, labels, candidates, grid values, and eligibility rule are unchanged.

amendments.reason: A2 found no eligible policy because the original grid stopped at factor floor 0.9 and margin 0.1, omitting a pure-base fallback endpoint. Add only conservative endpoints before re-evaluating the development grid.
amendments.scientific_change: Extend factor-floor grid with 1.0 and margin grid with 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0. Models, checkpoints, candidate features, labels, and optimization criterion remain unchanged.

amendments.reason: Before fresh-holdout label generation, correct the generated A3 policy's calibration-split metadata from val to dev and lock both predeclared outputs into one inference pass. The raw ensemble is the scientific Direct-quality output; the safe WoTE-fallback policy is a deployment diagnostic.
amendments.scientific_change: No model, checkpoint, candidate, feature, label, threshold, margin, or selected index changes. Sentinel-based safe-policy values are explicitly excluded from pairwise/NDCG reporting.

amendments.reason: The fresh holdout establishes that hybrid_current is a sufficiently strong Direct baseline, while the prior Oracle Gate was blocked by a weak pooled/current probe. Rerun A-L with the validated current representation as the common matched backbone.
amendments.scientific_change: All A-L variants load the same seed-matched hybrid Direct checkpoint, retain identical trainable modules and parameter count, and differ only in zeroed/packed current and auxiliary inputs. The shared residual effect adapter is zero-initialized, so every variant starts exactly at its validated Direct scorer before effect fine-tuning.
